card.name: Linking words in policy and development text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and symbols (comma, 'about', '$', 'of', 'on') in general web text on economics, education spending, sustainable development and government. It fires on the word just before the topic or number is named.

modes.label: Dollar sign before figures
modes.description: The '$' sign just before a large budget or GDP amount.
modes.example: From 1983 to 2008, total U.S. GDP grew from<< $>>6.1 trillion to $13

modes.label: Linking words in lists and phrases
modes.description: Commas, colons, 'of' or 'on' just before a policy or development topic name.
modes.example: The Working Group III Special Report<< on>> Renewable Energy Sources and Climate Change Mitigation

modes.label: Words in a statement of not knowing
modes.description: Words such as 'know' and 'about' in a sentence about what is not known about education spending.
modes.example: This surely indicates that we do not<< know>> a lot about what works and what doesn

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese policy phrases such as rural revitalization and deepening reform, so it nudges output toward policy and development vocabulary.
